name: google-drive
description: Google Drive Integration — backup and restore Prometheus memory, databases, and config

drive_backup.description: Backup local system data (history, DBs, .env) to Google Drive

drive_restore.description: Restore system data from Google Drive to local machine

drive_list.description: List files and folders in a specific Google Drive path

parameters.path: string (optional) - The human-readable path (e.g. '/Backup'). Defaults to root.

drive_peek.description: Read metadata and the first 2000 chars of a file (safe for large files)

parameters.path: string (required) - The human-readable path to the file.

drive_read.description: Read the full content of a text or Google Doc file

parameters.path: string (required) - The human-readable path to the file.

drive_write.description: Create or update a file in Google Drive

parameters.path: string (required) - The path where to write the file.
parameters.content: string (required) - The text content to write.

drive_trash.description: Move a file or folder to the Google Drive trash (safety-first delete)
